result.baseline_need: A new upstream-issue-derived known-exit failing baseline and healthy control on exact unmodified source are required for this new target. That is product reproduction, not an active-versus-Candidate model comparison. Do not replay old Twisted or planning evidence.
evidence_to_collect: Preserve Root239 fixed repository order/query/candidate budget and immutable search/issue/source receipts.
Lock one eligible target only after known product-assertion failure and healthy control pass; persist and verify baseline publication before repair.
One bounded patch iteration; identical post-patch test/control commands, exact exits/timeouts/digests, minimal diff and all negatives.
Truthful outcome: repair PASS only with reproduced defect repaired and controls retained; none eligible or environment unknown => NOT_EVALUABLE; unrepaired selected target => FAIL.
regression_checks: No linked fix/solution/comment inspection before trial; record and exclude accidental contamination.
No altered expected assertions/control tests, target replacement after lock, old trial replay, upstream writes, paid provider calls, secrets or new primary.
No protected prompt/workflow/O_OPERATIONS/DESIRED_STATE edits; unchanged exact-head CI and readback for O publications.

result.rollback: If target source identity or baseline provenance fails before repair, do not patch; record scoped ineligibility. After target lock do not replace the target; retain failed repair/control regressions and leave the upstream untouched. No Candidate was activated, so there is no overlay to roll back.
